name: Suruga Ryouko
source: Ryoko is the eldest of the three sisters. She works as an administrative assistant, along with Misaki Suou, her colleague and friend. Ryoko has been responsible for her younger sisters since their parents died. She is popular with the male employees at her company. The player must find a way to make Ryoko stand out and be noticed by male employees, who follow her around the office.
